purpose: the pre-registered invariance ladder, fitted one rung per process; rungs at 39 countries ARE the registered test, rungs at fewer are the subset diagnostic and are keyed separately

forced_deviations.category_collapsing: minimal merging until no category is empty in any country; required by lavaan, logged in preregistration Sec. 11
forced_deviations.se_none: standard errors not computed; the invariance decision is a delta in scaled CFI and no SE is consumed downstream
